primary_authorities.source_title: Convention relating to the Status of Stateless Persons
primary_authorities.notes: Defines stateless person and creates protection standards for persons not recognized as nationals by any state.

primary_authorities.source_title: Convention on the Reduction of Statelessness
primary_authorities.notes: Framework for preventing statelessness at birth, in loss of nationality, and in state succession contexts.
Article 15 recognizes the right to a nationality and protection against arbitrary deprivation.

primary_authorities.source_title: International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights
primary_authorities.notes: Protects legal personality, equality, family life, child registration, and related rights.

primary_authorities.source_title: Convention on the Rights of the Child
primary_authorities.notes: Article 7 addresses birth registration, name, and nationality for children.

primary_authorities.source_title: Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Discrimination against Women
primary_authorities.notes: Article 9 addresses equality in nationality law and transmission of nationality to children.

primary_authorities.source_title: International Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Racial Discrimination
primary_authorities.notes: Important for racialized nationality denial and discrimination in citizenship regimes.
UNHCR overview of the 1954 and 1961 statelessness conventions.

primary_authorities.source_title: Handbook on Protection of Stateless Persons
primary_authorities.notes: Guidance on definition, status determination, and protection for stateless persons.

primary_authorities.source_title: Global Action Plan to End Statelessness 2.0
primary_authorities.notes: Current UNHCR strategy for reducing and preventing statelessness.

further_reading.author: Blitz, B. and Lynch, M. (eds.)
further_reading.title: Statelessness and Citizenship: A Comparative Study on the Benefits of Nationality
further_reading.notes: Comparative study of nationality, exclusion, and practical consequences of statelessness.

further_reading.author: Edwards, A. and van Waas, L. (eds.)
further_reading.title: Nationality and Statelessness under International Law
further_reading.notes: Major scholarly collection on nationality, statelessness, and international protection.

further_reading.author: van Waas, L.
further_reading.title: Nationality Matters: Statelessness under International Law
further_reading.notes: Foundational monograph on statelessness doctrine and international law.

further_reading.author: Kingston, L.N.
further_reading.title: Fully Human: Personhood, Citizenship and Rights
further_reading.notes: Connects statelessness, personhood, dignity, and human rights.

further_reading.author: UNHCR
further_reading.title: Good Practices Paper: Action 6 - Establishing Statelessness Determination Procedures
further_reading.notes: Practical guidance on determination procedures and protection pathways.

statelessness_framework.core_question: Is the person not considered a national by any state under the operation of its law?
statelessness_framework.practice_use: Threshold classification for protection and determination procedures.

statelessness_framework.core_question: Has nationality been denied, withheld, or arbitrarily deprived?
statelessness_framework.practice_use: Frame claims involving legal identity, birth registration, and citizenship exclusion.

statelessness_framework.core_question: Was the child able to acquire a nationality at birth or soon after birth?
statelessness_framework.practice_use: Assess birth registration, foundling rules, and safeguards against inherited statelessness.

statelessness_framework.core_question: Do nationality laws discriminate in transmission, retention, or spouse/child nationality?
statelessness_framework.practice_use: Challenge unequal citizenship regimes and intergenerational statelessness.

statelessness_framework.core_question: Are nationality rules or practices excluding racial, ethnic, religious, or linguistic groups?
statelessness_framework.practice_use: Analyze structural discrimination and arbitrary deprivation.

statelessness_framework.legal_source: UDHR Article 15; human rights due process
statelessness_framework.core_question: Has nationality been stripped arbitrarily or without safeguards?
statelessness_framework.practice_use: Assess security-based citizenship deprivation and exile-by-law.

statelessness_framework.core_question: Is there a fair procedure to identify and protect stateless persons?
statelessness_framework.practice_use: Build administrative, litigation, or advisory pathways.

protection_pathways.legal_question: Does the person meet the Article 1 definition?
protection_pathways.output: Status recognition and protection against removal limbo.

protection_pathways.trigger: Child born without proof of legal identity
protection_pathways.legal_question: Can birth registration and nationality safeguards prevent statelessness?
Does nationality law discriminate contrary to CEDAW/equality norms?
protection_pathways.output: Legal reform, remedy, or individual recognition.

protection_pathways.trigger: Ethnic or religious group excluded from citizenship
protection_pathways.institutional_actor: Court, treaty body, human rights mechanism
protection_pathways.output: Recognition, remedy, monitoring, or advocacy record.

protection_pathways.trigger: Person is both stateless and displaced
protection_pathways.legal_question: Does refugee law, statelessness law, or complementary protection apply?

protection_pathways.trigger: Person cannot be removed because no state recognizes them
protection_pathways.legal_question: Is detention arbitrary when removal is not reasonably foreseeable?
protection_pathways.output: Release, status regularization, or alternative measures.
